text.p: Pakhoed NV said on Thursday it had obtained two subordinated loans with a combined value of 150 million guilders, thus completing a 350 million guilder financing operation announced in October.

The tank storage and shipping group said the loans had been provided by several institutional investors and financial institutions with ING Bank acting as underwriter and agent and De Nationale Investeringsbank as co-underwriter.
Both loans have a 10-year maturity and are repayable in 16 semi-annual instalments starting June 1, 1999.
Pakhoed said one of the loans, worth 100 million guilders, ws repayable at Pakhoed's discretion either in cash or in new ordinary shares.
Based on current prices this could lead to the issue of a maximum of 1.96 million shares and maximum dilution of earnings per share of 0.8 percent per year in 1999-2006, it said.
Pakhoed said the subordinated loans completed a 350 million guilder financing operation which further comprised an earlier 200 million guilder issue of cumulative preference shares.
The entire operation, arranged by ING Barings, had raised Pakhoed's risk-bearing capital to around 30 percent of total assets, it said.
